title: Goblin Scouts
description: Watch-Sergeant Coel Renn has counted four goblin scouts at the forest edge in a week, always in pairs, always moving north to south like they're marking something. Scouts this organized don't come without a column somewhere behind them, and the garrison hasn't the men to go find out where it's camped. Kill what shows itself; that's the only intelligence Dalhurst can currently afford.

objectives.description: Kill the goblin scouts marking the forest edge before more come

notes: Threat: organized goblin scouting (paired, patterned movement) implies a column behind it the garrison cannot locate. Giver motive: Watch-Sergeant Renn can't spare men to track the column, so the bounty buys what reconnaissance it can. Refusal: the scouting continues unopposed and whatever is behind it closes the distance unwatched.
